info.title: Nueces Transition at a glance
info.mapFocus: (KNGP) Corpus Christi NAS/Nueces Transition / East Arrivals & Departures/KCRP
instructions: Rapid transit between KNGP and the landing pattern at Corpus Christi International
Outbound: 1,500' MSL · 200 KIAS to the Crosstown Expressway
Inbound: 1,000' MSL · 200 KIAS, north of SPID
Contact Cabaniss Tower · UHF CH 27 or Corpus Christi Tower · UHF CH 34 as directed
KCRP phraseology is not in the sources. Check with an instructor.
